86ac5f42203c.en: The small places between the cities, grouped by region: Freeish, Gandew, Tolerideme, Sanbi and beyond. Each entry says why the village exists and what it is known for. Banhia feeds travelers on the road between Forway and Deltacross, Cliffbay keeps a lighthouse, and Fiera's Hut is famous for pies made from recipes passed down for generations.
86ac5f42203c.t: Tempat-tempat kecil di antara bandar, dikumpulkan mengikut wilayah: Freeish, Gandew, Tolerideme, Sanbi dan seterusnya. Setiap entri menyatakan sebab kampung itu wujud dan apa yang terkenal tentangnya. Banhia memberi makan pengembara di jalan antara Forway dan Deltacross, Cliffbay menjaga rumah api, dan Fiera's Hut terkenal dengan pai yang dibuat daripada resipi turun-temurun.
